credentials.name: KUBERNETES_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY
credentials.description: Controls whether a client verifies the server's certificate chain and host name. If is true, it accepts any certificate presented by the server and any host name in that certificate. Defaults to false if no value is provided.

credentials.name: KUBERNETES_BEARER_TOKEN
credentials.description: The bearer token to authenticate with Kubernetes. It defaults reading the token from the service account when running inside the Kubernetes cluster.
